title: Partial ROM remains after interrupted output write
reproduction_steps: Inject ENOSPC after 128 bytes using the same real source and patch: v09b leaves final partial file; v09c leaves none.
actual_result: Injected ENOSPC after 128 bytes leaves a 128-byte .gba at the final path
root_cause: Applicator publishes the destination name before write/flush/read-back completes and has no failure cleanup
v09c_fix_summary: Write/read-back/fsync a unique sibling temporary file before no-overwrite publication; clean only owned outputs on failure.
fix_commit: Recorded by bug ID in Git; see fix_history.md
hardware_retest_required: User checklist including each bug; host-only defect itself needs no console reproduction
notes: Frozen v0.9b remains unchanged; v0.9c-only fix

title: Package accepts contradictory version and size metadata
reproduction_steps: Authentic frozen build plus WRONG_VERSION/source_size=1/patch_size=2: old packager accepts; new validator rejects. Missing/extra/nested wrong-type values also rejected.
actual_result: Authentic ROM/BPS with version WRONG_VERSION, source_size 1, patch_size 2 is packaged successfully
root_cause: Packager validates hashes but trusts version, source_size and patch_size from the build manifest
v09c_fix_summary: Validate every candidate manifest field, nested value type, actual size/hash, provenance and no-release status before packaging.
